name: Trakt
description: Keeps your Trakt watch history in step with what you actually watch here. Each person connects their own Trakt account, and nobody else's viewing is ever sent.
author: Multipass

settings.label: Trakt client ID
settings.help: Create an application at trakt.tv/oauth/applications. Use 'urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob' as the redirect URI.

settings.label: Trakt client secret
settings.help: From the same application page. Stored on this server and never shown again.
